clips.title: The story
paras: In Mulgore, young tauren hunters learn to live and hunt beside a beast. After proving their patience and resolve by soothing the plains’ wild creatures, they travel to Thunder Bluff to learn the lasting bond of care and command.

After facing plainstriders, prairie stalkers, and swoops in Mulgore, tauren hunters are ready to take up the full mantle of the hunter. Yaw Sharpmane, their mentor in Bloodhoof Village, sends each novice to Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. There, Holt Thunderhorn teaches them. The shu'halo honor him for communing with the wilds, and his reverence for the Earthmother is greater still.

To the tauren, a beast is a partner joined through harmony with the natural world, never a weapon or thrall. Holt Thunderhorn teaches hunters how to sustain that bond. They learn to guide a creature's combat instincts, feed it regularly, mend its injuries, and call its spirit back if it falls defending its companion on the plains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it.
Travel to Thunder Bluff. There you must speak to one of our most revered hunters, Holt Thunderhorn. If he deems you worthy, he will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Holt has bested the most powerful and feared beasts of Azeroth, and commands many strong creatures of his own. His ties to the Earthmother are strong, and you can learn much from him. Good luck, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A young adventurer, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
Now, go forth. May the Earthmother guide you on your path. We shall speak again, at a later date.
